phase: Step12F-P9 round 3 input-cache fill write accept/commit isolation
objective: Move sparse input mapping and physical slot/bank selection behind an atomic registered write command, commit data and validity together, and qualify SLOT_READY only after the final accepted write commits.

write_command_contract.lifecycle: sparse input fire -> mapping/target generation -> registered fill-write command -> same-edge data_mem and valid_mem commit
write_command_contract.atomicity: one command valid and one one-hot slot/bank target; data and validity are committed together
write_command_contract.elasticity: fill_wr_cmd_ready = !fill_wr_cmd_valid_q || fill_wr_cmd_commit; commit and refill are allowed on the same edge
write_command_contract.input_fire: it_data_in_vld && it_data_in_req, with it_data_in_req gated by fill_active and fill_wr_cmd_ready
write_command_contract.end_fire: it_data_end && it_data_in_req; it_data_end is independent of it_data_in_vld
write_command_contract.address_source: input-cache write enable/address/data ports are driven from fill_wr_cmd_*_q, not live fill_slot/slot_width/address decode
write_command_contract.validity_pairing: data_mem write and valid_mem set use the same command target/address and commit edge
write_command_contract.completion: end with final data records fill_end_pending; SLOT_READY occurs only when that command commits; end-only creates no data command
write_command_contract.scrub: scrub clears valid_mem only; delayed fill commit must target a different ownership slot

toolchain_validation.reason: vsim/vlog/xsim/xvlog/iverilog/verilator/vivado were not found on PATH or in the checked installation locations

functional: final data plus end same cycle
continuous sparse input at one point per cycle
accepted command count equals committed command count
physical: live mapping to data_mem/valid_mem WE and WADDR absent
command Q to data_mem/valid_mem WE/WADDR/WDATA timing
fresh fully routed setup/hold and worst-500 classification
